overview: Belleville had 55,071 residents in 2021, up 8.6% from 50,716 in 2016, living in 23,536 occupied homes on 247.15 square kilometres. The median age is 47.5 and the median household income in 2020 was $73,000.

The city is growing faster than many older Ontario centres, while its population skews older. Local businesses serve both long-time residents and new arrivals, plus workers at food plants and other employers across the Bay of Quinte.
